title: The Naginata Second Course
summary: A second course that builds on the primer and teaches students to carry qi out along the curved edge.

title: Blade-Root and Haft Intermediate Reader
summary: A reader on close guarding near the blade root and the haft for students who already circulate qi.

title: A Treatise on the Spinning Guard
summary: A treatise on turning the shaft in wheels and rings to guard and to release long sweeps with qi.

title: Qi Along the Curved Edge
summary: A short guide to feeding qi along the whole curve of the blade so the cut reaches farther than the steel.

title: Counter-Sweep Lessons
summary: Lessons that teach a student to turn a parry into a sweeping answer before the foe can reset.

title: The Shaft-Slide Compendium
summary: A compendium of grips that slide along the shaft to lengthen or shorten the reach of every stroke.

title: Reach and Return Naginata Study
summary: A study of the outward reach and the inward return of each cut and how qi joins the two.

title: Notes on Hooking and Pulling with the Blade Back
summary: Notes on using the back of the blade and the shaft to hook limbs and weapons and pull the foe open.

title: The Steady Shaft Canon
summary: A canon on holding the shaft steady under force and answering pressure with qi from a fixed stance.
